source: Onkelos on Exod 34:1-4; the privacy condition at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 31
claim_en: The second tablets human-hewn and God-written — the torn-contract parable: you tore it, you supply the parchment and I write; the sapphire quarry revealed in Moses' own tent — the Torah feeds its laborer; and the PRIVACY CONDITION: the first given in public thunder broke under the evil eye, the second given with no man seen — nothing finer than modesty (Onkelos Exod 34; Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 31).

source: Onkelos on Exod 34:5-7; the taught-prayer frame at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 32; the docket row Mishnah Yoma 4:2
claim_en: Distancing anger, making goodness and truth abound — and the clears/clears-not paradox split by a CONDITION: He forgives THOSE WHO RETURN TO HIS TORAH and does not acquit those who do not return; the visiting scoped to REBELLIOUS sons (Onkelos Exod 34). The frame: He TAUGHT Moses how to plead — the attributes as the standing appeal liturgy (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 32); the confession formula's case row waits (Mishnah Yoma 4:2, this exam's docket).

Three forties: down on the seventeenth of Tammuz with the tablets broken; the middle forty of pleading; up on the first of Elul, down on THE TENTH OF TISHREI with I-HAVE-PARDONED — the Day of Atonement fixed as the standing pardon-day for the generations, and the sanctuary commanded IMMEDIATELY after: EX25-09's no-earlier-and-later timestamp confirmed by the spine at its own home parashah, calendar spelled out (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 31). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 34:18-26; docket rows Mishnah Bekhorot 1:2, Mishnah Sheviit 1:4, Mishnah Pesachim 5:4
claim_en: The firstborn laws (the donkey redeemed with a sheep or neck-broken; none appear empty-handed — Mishnah Bekhorot 1:2 and its cluster, this docket); rest even IN PLOWING AND HARVEST (Mishnah Sheviit 1:4's row); the three appearances before the MASTER OF THE WORLD; no slaughter of MY PASSOVER over leaven (Mishnah Pesachim 5:4, pairing EX23's claim); the fats not overnight EXCEPT off the altar; the firstfruits to the SANCTUARY-HOUSE; and the third meat-milk EAT-ban — the triple complete (Onkelos Exod 34).

source: Onkelos on Exod 34:27; the charter at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 34; the translation-law at Mishnah Megillah 4:10
claim_en: BY THE SAYING of these words the covenant is cut (Onkelos Exod 34) — and the spine unfolds the two channels: Scripture in writing, Mishnah and Talmud ORAL; the Greek-translation foresight — the Oral is MY SECRET, the identity-proof; and the reversal-clause: exchange the channels and THE COVENANT IS VOID (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 34). The Oral-Torah charter at its own verse — with the case shelf regulating this very instrument: the calf's second account read but NOT translated (Mishnah Megillah 4:10, this exam's docket).

source: Onkelos on Exod 34:29-35; the sources dispute at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 37
claim_en: The radiance rendered glory, not horns; the veil the FACE-HOUSE — removed before the LORD, worn at broadcast: bare at the interface, veiled to the public (Onkelos Exod 34). The sources dispute rides: the cave's sheltering hand, the tablets' middle handbreadths, or THE LEFTOVER INK passed over his head — the writing itself radiates (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 37).

Redemption precedes neck-breaking; designation precedes redemption — quoting this corpus' own Exod 21:8; yibbum once preceded chalitzah and the order FLIPPED when intention decayed; the owner precedes all in redeeming (Mishnah Bekhorot 1:7): a cross-domain precedence algebra with a recorded historical flip. Seated from the Step 9 Ki Tisa exam, auto-seat law.

THE EQUINOX TRIGGER AND THE HARVEST REST. The intercalation's astronomical trigger written at the turn-of-the-year clause: the ingathering festival must meet the new season — R. Yehuda (the whole festival, sixteen days; the equinox day completes), R. Yosei (part, twenty-one; the day begins), Acherim (fourteen — at Nisan's spring equinox or at Tishrei whole-plus-first-day, both placements preserved). The year seam beside it: the going-out of the year fixed by the one-third growth threshold, with R. Zeira's all-the-Sages'-measures-are-thus — the data channel self-labeled at the calendar's seam. And the harvest rest (34:21): R. Akiva to the sabbatical's edges (sanctity extended both ways) vs R. Yishmael's Sabbath assignment with the omer carved out — both arms recorded. Filed F-081, auto-seated (round 22, the calendar block).

THE ATTRIBUTES COVENANT AND THE CONFESSION FORMULA. The recital instituted inside the theophany — the Holy One wrapped as a prayer leader showing Moses the order ('whenever Israel sin, let them perform this order and I forgive'); the doubled Name as before-the-sin and after-the-repentance; the covenant CUT to the thirteen attributes that they never return empty (34:10). The confession's order disputed on 34:7's own sequence (R. Meir with the verse's order; the Sages from the lightest). The please-opener from Horeb (32:30-31) with Abaye's KASHYA carried as a recorded standing difficulty. The graze-ban's proclamation release (34:3). Filed F-085, auto-seated (round 23, the covenant block).

THE PILGRIMAGE WARRANTY AND THE ERRING COURT. Isi ben Yehuda on 34:24's own covet clause: the ascent's property warranty (the cow in the meadow, the hen at the rubbish) with the a-fortiori to persons and the return-in-peace leg. And the erring court on 34:21: 'no Shabbat in the Sabbatical' as the recorded error class — R. Zeira's dilemma RESOLVED by Ravina from the prophet baraita as PARTIAL nullification with partial fulfillment, riding EX34-08's harvest-rest arm seated one round earlier. Filed F-090, auto-seated (round 24, the festivals block).

THE BOWING FILE'S OFFICE. This clause is the punished bow's WARNING (the punishment rides the Deuteronomy juxtaposition); Abaye's census — THREE bowing verses in the idolatry file, one for the idol worshiped by bowing, one for the idol not so worshiped, one TO DIVIDE — each assigned its office; the one-lapse service unification beside it (you-shall-not-serve-them made all the services one); and the love-or-fear perimeter disputed (Abaye liable by the Haman proof; Rava exempt). Filed F-094, auto-seated (round 25, the capital block).
